summary: This Eco Experts page, titled Solar Panel Costs UK 2024 and written by Josh Jackman and reviewed by Charlie Clissitt, estimates what solar panels cost in the UK by house size and breaks down installation costs into parts, business costs and labour. It also covers annual bill savings, the break-even period, the cost of adding a solar battery, the Smart Export Guarantee, grant and finance options, and maintenance costs such as inverter replacement. The note is cut off partway through its FAQ section, and the page's site navigation and banners were ignored.
one_line: UK guide to solar panel costs in 2024, covering house-size estimates, installation cost breakdown, savings, break-even time, batteries and maintenance.
key_facts: The average cost of buying and installing one 350W solar panel is £703.
A solar panel system suitable for a three-bedroom house typically costs £7,026.
Solar panels will reduce electricity bills by 70% on average, saving £537 per year.
The cost of going solar has dropped by 82% since 2010, according to the International Renewable Agency (IRENA).
The average household breaks even on solar panels in 13.08 years, according to The Eco Experts' calculations.
A 1-2 bedroom house needs 6 panels (2.1 kWp) costing £4,216 on average; a 4-5 bedroom house needs 14 panels (4.9 kWp) costing £9,837.
The average cost of a solar battery for a three-bedroom house is £4,500.
Typically 40-50% of installation costs go towards materials, including panels, brackets and an inverter that costs around £3,150 for the average three-bedroom household.
Business costs make up 30-40% of the price, coming to around £2,450 for an average 3.5 kWp installation.
Labour makes up 10-30% of the cost, with a labour cost range of £800-£2,000.
A new inverter will cost between £500 and £1,000, and inverters only last for 10 years.
Small solar panel breakages can be fixed for £80, while sweeping repairs could cost up to £1,500.
Professional solar panel cleaning costs around £100.
Solar Together is a group-buying scheme that can save 30-35% on the cost of solar panels.
Solar panel installation usually takes one to two days, while installations of over 14 panels can take up to four days.
